arguments.command:
python -c "
import parse
from parse import RepeatedNameError, Parser

# Additional edge case tests

print('=== Additional R1 Tests ===')

# Letter with uppercase and lowercase
p = Parser('{name:l}')
r = p.parse('HelloWorld')
print(f'Mixed case letters: {r.named}')
assert r.named == {'name': 'HelloWorld'}

# Letter empty match shouldn't work (needs + not *)
r2 = p.parse('')
print(f'Empty input for letters: {r2} (should be None)')
assert r2 is None

print()
print('=== Additional R2 Tests ===')

# __contains__ with non-existent key
p = Parser('{a}:{b}')
r = p.parse('1:2')
print(f'\"c\" in result: {\"c\" in r}')
assert 'c' not in r

# __contains__ with value that's a substring of another value
r3 = p.parse('abc:def')
print(f'\"ab\" in result: {\"ab\" in r3}')
assert 'ab' not in r3  # Should be exact match only

# __contains__ on fixed-only result
p4 = Parser('{}:{}')
r4 = p4.parse('x:y')
print(f'0 in fixed result: {0 in r4}')
print(f'\"x\" in fixed result: {\"x\" in r4}')
assert 0 in r4
assert 'x' in r4

print()
print('=== Additional R3 Tests ===')

# Multiple escaped braces
p5 = Parser('{{a}} {{b}}')
r5 = p5.parse('{a} {b}')
print(f'Multiple escaped braces: {r5}')
assert r5 is not None

# Field inside escaped brace context  
p6 = Parser('prefix_{name}_suffix')
r6 = p6.parse('prefix_John_suffix')
print(f'Field with surrounding text: {r6.named}')
assert r6.named == {'name': 'John'}

# Pattern that looks like it could be nested but isn't
p7 = Parser('{outer}_{inner}')
r7 = p7.parse('a_b')
print(f'Underscores in values: {r7.named}')
assert r7.named == {'outer': 'a', 'inner': 'b'}

print()
print('ALL ADDITIONAL TESTS PASSED!')
" 2>&1 | grep -v SyntaxWarning
